title: IPSO Direct codec for Python
description:
Implement IPSO Direct encoding/decoding in python/src/lichen/ipso_direct.py

- Encode Python values to bare CBOR for IPSO resources
- Decode CBOR payloads to Python values
- Path parser for /{object}/{instance}/{resource}
- Type inference from IPSO registry (float for 5700, bool for 5850, etc.)
- Reference: spec/07-transport-app.md section 10.2.2

Test: assert round-trip encode/decode for temp, humidity, light on/off
